requirements.requirement: Enforce separate Core, implementation, API and provider compilation projects when present; one package, activation bundle or deployment does not waive those roles. Reject namespace waivers, role relabeling and omitted active capabilities. Verify evaluated/compiled dependencies, actual feature activation/resolution/lifetimes and compatibility. Review serializers and provider settings hidden behind BCL types; dependency prefixes cannot prove semantic ownership. When the published Foundation host is selected, verify the application release bundle on its unchanged digest-pinned host, including activation/restart as applicable. A substantively accepted alternative host uses its documented adapter.
